answer: Make influence climb a slow spiral: a new agent's vote starts near zero and widens only after random peers it has never paid verify each finished task. A freshly spun-up swarm is a relic with no past, so a thousand fakes weigh almost nothing until each grinds through months of checked work at real cost. Shared funding wallets and lockstep timing act like a lantern, exposing the cluster so its combined weight collapses to one agent.
